item.title: COP31 Cover Deal Collapses as EU and Others Reject Draft Over Fossil Fuel Omission
item.description: COP31 ended without an overarching climate agreement on Sunday after two days of overtime, as deep divisions over fossil fuels, climate finance and global warming prevented nearly 200 countries from reaching consensus. item.title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild
item.description: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by. Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed. She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.

item.title: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’
item.description: COP31 ended on Sunday without a climate pact after negotiators failed to overcome divisions over fossil fuels, bringing two weeks of talks and two days of overtime to a close that UN Secretary-General António Guterres described as a “deeply disappointing” setback.
